convertibility_reason: Uses external custom signal library CBE_BE_Stoch from MySignals .mqh, which contains the core trading logic not visible in the EA itself. Requires reading/translating the custom .mqh signal filter to understand entry/exit rules.

derived_values.name: Signal weighted vote from CBE_BE_Stoch filter

other_exits: Signal threshold close: CBE_BE_Stoch signal crosses below Signal_ThresholdClose (20) to close position

custom_logic_notes: Core entry/exit logic is encapsulated in the external CBE_BE_Stoch signal filter class from ACBE_BE_Stoch.mqh. The EA delegates all trading decisions to CExpert framework with this single signal filter. The 'BE' in the name suggests Breakeven logic may be embedded in the custom signal class. Signal_ThresholdOpen=40 and Signal_ThresholdClose=20 mean the weighted signal must reach 40/100 to open and drop below 20/100 to close. SL/TP are both 0, meaning the signal class or CExpert framework handles exits via signal reversal. Expert_EveryTick=false confirms bar-based processing.
python_conversion_notes: The CBE_BE_Stoch signal filter class must be read from ACBE_BE_Stoch.mqh to extract the actual Stochastic+MA crossover logic for entry/exit. Without it, only the framework skeleton is known. The CExpert framework handles position management, signal weighting, and threshold comparison automatically - this boilerplate can be replaced with direct order logic in Python. The Stochastic(47,9,13) and MA(5) parameters are known, but the exact conditions (e.g. Stoch crosses above/below MA, or Stoch main/signal crossover, overbought/oversold levels) must be extracted from the .mqh file.
